children: India Cements on Thursday said that the company has entered into energy supply and share subscription agreement to acquire 3.62 per cent equity shares of Zenataris Renewable Energy Private Ltd, a company engaged in generation and transmission of renewable energy.

“The acquisition is for the purposes of meeting India Cements’ green energy needs, optimising energy cost and comply with regulatory requirements for captive power consumption under electricity laws,” the company said in a filing to the exchanges.
The consideration involved is an equity investment of over ₹20 crore and it will be closed within 120 days from the execution of the agreement.

Zenataris is based in Hyderabad, and is a special purpose vehicle (SPV) established for the development and operation of Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS) hybrid renewable energy project located at Kudligi, Vijayanagara District, Karnataka.
The SPV shall supply 11 MW renewable energy to the cement plants of India Cements on a group captive basis, a statement filed by India Cements to the exchanges said.

title: India Cements acquires 3.6% stake in Zenataris Renewable for captive power needs
